name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.leastRealizer_eq_concat
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_eq_concat {j N : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N = leastRealizer d j + 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * concatBlock d j N
proof:
:= by
  rw [concatBlock, ← leastRealizer_mod hd hj, Nat.mod_add_div]

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.concat_lt
statement:
theorem concat_lt {j N : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ N) :
    concatBlock d j N < 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [S_shiftWord d hj, concatBlock, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by positivity), ← pow_add]
  have h := leastRealizer_lt d N
  have hS := S_mono d hj
  calc leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ (S d N + 1) := h
    _ = 2 ^ (S d N - S d j + (S d j + 1)) := by congr 1; omega

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.concat_modEq
statement:
theorem concat_modEq {j N : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    orbit (leastRealizer d j) j + 2 * 3 ^ j * concatBlock d j N ≡
      leastRealizer (shiftWord d j) (N - j) [MOD 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j) + 1)]
proof:
:= by
  have hrest := (EOC.cylinder_restart_leastRealizer d j (concatBlock d j N) hj1
    fun i hi => hd i (by omega)).2
  rw [← leastRealizer_eq_concat hd hj] at hrest
  rw [← hrest]
  exact modEq_leastRealizer_of_realizes
    (realizes_shiftWord (leastRealizer_realizes_all d N hd) hj)

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.concat_unique
statement:
theorem concat_unique {j N k : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N)
    (hk : k < 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j)))
    (hmod : orbit (leastRealizer d j) j + 2 * 3 ^ j * k ≡
      leastRealizer (shiftWord d j) (N - j) [MOD 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j) + 1)]) :
    k = concatBlock d j N
proof:
:= by
  set t := S (shiftWord d j) (N - j)
  have h1 := concat_modEq hj1 hd hj
  have h2 : 2 * (3 ^ j * k) ≡ 2 * (3 ^ j * concatBlock d j N) [MOD 2 * 2 ^ t] := by
    have := Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' _ (hmod.trans h1.symm)
    rw [pow_succ, mul_comm (2 ^ t) 2] at this
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this
  have h3 := Nat.ModEq.mul_left_cancel' (by norm_num) h2
  have hcop : Nat.gcd (2 ^ t) (3 ^ j) = 1 :=
    Nat.Coprime.pow t j (by norm_num : Nat.Coprime 2 3)
  exact (Nat.ModEq.cancel_left_of_coprime hcop h3).eq_of_lt_of_lt hk (concat_lt hj)

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.lt_pow_iff_concat
statement:
theorem lt_pow_iff_concat {j N K : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) (hK : S d j < K) :
    leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ K ↔ concatBlock d j N < 2 ^ (K - S d j - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leastRealizer_eq_concat hd hj]
  have hlt := leastRealizer_lt d j
  have hpow : 2 ^ K = 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * 2 ^ (K - S d j - 1) := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  rw [hpow]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    replace hc := not_lt.mp hc
    have : 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * 2 ^ (K - S d j - 1) ≤ 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * concatBlock d j N :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
    omega
  · intro h
    have : 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * (concatBlock d j N + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * 2 ^ (K - S d j - 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h
    rw [mul_add, mul_one] at this
    omega

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.bilinear_incidence_sq_le
statement:
theorem bilinear_incidence_sq_le (Y I : Finset G) (N : G → ℝ) :
    (∑ y ∈ Y, ∑ i ∈ I, N (y - i) -
        (Y.card : ℝ) * I.card * ((∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G)) ^ 2 ≤
      (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * Y.card * ∑ z, (N z - (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set μ := (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G
  set g : G → ℝ := fun z => N z - μ
  set F : G → ℝ := fun z => ∑ i ∈ I, g (z - i)
  have hL : ∑ y ∈ Y, ∑ i ∈ I, N (y - i) - (Y.card : ℝ) * I.card * μ = ∑ y ∈ Y, F y := by
    simp only [F, g, sum_sub_distrib, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hL]
  
  have hCS1 : (∑ y ∈ Y, F y) ^ 2 ≤ (Y.card : ℝ) * ∑ y ∈ Y, F y ^ 2 := by
    have := sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Y (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) F
    simpa using this
  
  have hext : ∑ y ∈ Y, F y ^ 2 ≤ ∑ z, F z ^ 2 :=
    sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ Y) fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  
  have hCS2 : ∀ z, F z ^ 2 ≤ (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I, g (z - i) ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    have := sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq I (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) fun i => g (z - i)
    simpa [F] using this
  have htrans : ∀ i : G, ∑ z, g (z - i) ^ 2 = ∑ z, g z ^ 2 := fun i =>
    Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight i) _ _ fun _ => rfl
  have hall : ∑ z, F z ^ 2 ≤ (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ z, g z ^ 2 := by
    calc ∑ z, F z ^ 2 ≤ ∑ z, (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I, g (z - i) ^ 2 :=
          sum_le_sum fun z _ => hCS2 z
      _ = (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ z, g (z - i) ^ 2 := by rw [← mul_sum, sum_comm]
      _ = (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ _i ∈ I, ∑ z, g z ^ 2 := by rw [sum_congr rfl fun i _ => htrans i]
      _ = (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ z, g z ^ 2 := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hY : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Y.card := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  calc (∑ y ∈ Y, F y) ^ 2 ≤ (Y.card : ℝ) * ∑ y ∈ Y, F y ^ 2 := hCS1
    _ ≤ (Y.card : ℝ) * ((I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ z, g z ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hext.trans hall) hY
    _ = (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * Y.card * ∑ z, g z ^ 2 := by ring

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.bilinear_incidence_le
statement:
theorem bilinear_incidence_le (Y I : Finset G) (N : G → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hμ : 0 ≤ (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G)
    (hcoll : ∑ z, (N z - (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G) ^ 2 ≤
      ε ^ 2 * Y.card * ((∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G) ^ 2) :
    ∑ y ∈ Y, ∑ i ∈ I, N (y - i) ≤
      (1 + ε) * ((Y.card : ℝ) * I.card * ((∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G))
proof:
:= by
  set μ := (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G
  set L := ∑ y ∈ Y, ∑ i ∈ I, N (y - i)
  set main := (Y.card : ℝ) * I.card * μ
  have hsq := bilinear_incidence_sq_le Y I N
  have hmain : 0 ≤ main := by positivity
  have hbound : (L - main) ^ 2 ≤ (ε * main) ^ 2 := by
    calc (L - main) ^ 2 ≤ (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * Y.card * ∑ z, (N z - μ) ^ 2 := hsq
      _ ≤ (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * Y.card * (ε ^ 2 * Y.card * μ ^ 2) := by gcongr
      _ = (ε * main) ^ 2 := by simp only [main]; ring
  have hεm : 0 ≤ ε * main := mul_nonneg hε hmain
  have := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hbound hεm
  linarith [this.2]

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.term_nonneg
statement: theorem term_nonneg (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (n j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ term n p q j
proof:
:= by
  unfold term; positivity

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.sum_binom_eq_one
statement:
theorem sum_binom_eq_one (n : ℕ) (hpq : p + q = 1) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), term n p q j = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_pow p q n
  rw [hpq, one_pow] at h
  have hrw : ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), term n p q j
      = ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), p ^ m * q ^ (n - m) * (n.choose m : ℝ) := by
    refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    unfold term
    ring
  rw [hrw, ← h]

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.term_succ_mul
statement:
theorem term_succ_mul (n j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) (p q : ℝ) :
    term n p q (j + 1) * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q) = term n p q j * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold term
  have hrec : n.choose (j + 1) * (j + 1) = n.choose j * (n - j) := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq n j
  have hrec' : ((n.choose (j + 1) : ℝ)) * ((j : ℝ) + 1)
      = (n.choose j : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)) := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ)) hrec
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hj.le] at hc
    linarith
  have hq : q ^ (n - (j + 1)) * q = q ^ (n - j) := by
    rw [← pow_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  calc (n.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) * p ^ (j + 1) * q ^ (n - (j + 1)) * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q)
      = ((n.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) * p ^ j * p * (q ^ (n - (j + 1)) * q) := by
        rw [pow_succ]; ring
    _ = ((n.choose j : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - (j : ℝ))) * p ^ j * p * q ^ (n - j) := by rw [hrec', hq]
    _ = (n.choose j : ℝ) * p ^ j * q ^ (n - j) * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p) := by ring

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.cast_pos
statement: private theorem cast_pos (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) : (0 : ℝ) < n
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < n := by omega
  exact_mod_cast this

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.term_le_succ
statement:
theorem term_le_succ (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) (hjk : j < k)
    (hp : p = (k : ℝ) / n) (hq : q = ((n : ℝ) - k) / n) :
    term n p q j ≤ term n p q (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := cast_pos n k hk0 hkn
  have hkn' : (k : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hkn
  have hjn : j < n := by omega
  have hjn' : (j : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hjn
  have hjk' : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hjk
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by rw [hp]; positivity
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by rw [hq]; exact div_pos (by linarith) hn0
  have hrec := term_succ_mul n j hjn p q
  have hTj : 0 ≤ term n p q j := term_nonneg hp0.le hq0.le n j
  have hA : (0 : ℝ) < ((j : ℝ) + 1) * q := by positivity
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hnum : ((j : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - k) ≤ ((n : ℝ) - j) * (k : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hjk' hn0.le]
  have hkey : ((j : ℝ) + 1) * q ≤ ((n : ℝ) - j) * p := by
    have e1 : ((j : ℝ) + 1) * q = (((j : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - k)) / n := by rw [hq]; ring
    have e2 : ((n : ℝ) - j) * p = (((n : ℝ) - j) * (k : ℝ)) / n := by rw [hp]; ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    gcongr
  have hstep : term n p q j * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q) ≤ term n p q (j + 1) * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q) := by
    calc term n p q j * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q)
        ≤ term n p q j * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hTj
      _ = term n p q (j + 1) * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q) := hrec.symm
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hstep hA

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.term_succ_le
statement:
theorem term_succ_le (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hjn : j < n)
    (hp : p = (k : ℝ) / n) (hq : q = ((n : ℝ) - k) / n) :
    term n p q (j + 1) ≤ term n p q j
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := cast_pos n k hk0 hkn
  have hkn' : (k : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hkn
  have hjn' : (j : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hjn
  have hkj' : (k : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkj
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by rw [hp]; positivity
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by rw [hq]; exact div_pos (by linarith) hn0
  have hrec := term_succ_mul n j hjn p q
  have hTj1 : 0 ≤ term n p q (j + 1) := term_nonneg hp0.le hq0.le n (j + 1)
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) < ((n : ℝ) - j) * p := by
    apply mul_pos (by linarith) hp0
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hnum : ((n : ℝ) - j) * (k : ℝ) ≤ ((j : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - k) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkj' hn0.le]
  have hkey : ((n : ℝ) - j) * p ≤ ((j : ℝ) + 1) * q := by
    have e1 : ((j : ℝ) + 1) * q = (((j : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) - k)) / n := by rw [hq]; ring
    have e2 : ((n : ℝ) - j) * p = (((n : ℝ) - j) * (k : ℝ)) / n := by rw [hp]; ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    gcongr
  have hstep : term n p q (j + 1) * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p)
      ≤ term n p q j * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p) := by
    calc term n p q (j + 1) * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p)
        ≤ term n p q (j + 1) * (((j : ℝ) + 1) * q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hTj1
      _ = term n p q j * (((n : ℝ) - j) * p) := hrec
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hstep hB

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.term_le_term_max
statement:
theorem term_le_term_max (n k : ℕ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n)
    (hp : p = (k : ℝ) / n) (hq : q = ((n : ℝ) - k) / n) :
    ∀ j ≤ n, term n p q j ≤ term n p q k
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  rcases le_or_gt j k with hjk | hjk
  · 
    have aux : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, i + d = k → term n p q i ≤ term n p q k := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero => intro i hi; rw [show i = k by omega]
      | succ d ih =>
        intro i hi
        have h1 : term n p q i ≤ term n p q (i + 1) :=
          term_le_succ n k i hk0 hkn (by omega) hp hq
        exact le_trans h1 (ih (i + 1) (by omega))
    exact aux (k - j) j (by omega)
  · 
    have aux : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, k + d = i → i ≤ n → term n p q i ≤ term n p q k := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero => intro i hi _; rw [show i = k by omega]
      | succ d ih =>
        intro i hi hin
        have hprev : term n p q (k + d + 1) ≤ term n p q (k + d) :=
          term_succ_le n k (k + d) hk0 hkn (by omega) (by omega) hp hq
        have := ih (k + d) rfl (by omega)
        rw [show i = k + d + 1 by omega]
        exact le_trans hprev this
    exact aux (j - k) j (by omega) hj

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.one_le_succ_mul_choose_mul
statement:
theorem one_le_succ_mul_choose_mul (n k : ℕ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (n.choose k : ℝ) *
      ((k : ℝ) / n) ^ k * (((n : ℝ) - k) / n) ^ (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  set p : ℝ := (k : ℝ) / n with hp
  set q : ℝ := ((n : ℝ) - k) / n with hq
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := cast_pos n k hk0 hkn
  have hpq : p + q = 1 := by
    rw [hp, hq]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hsum := sum_binom_eq_one (p := p) (q := q) n hpq
  have hmax := term_le_term_max n k hk0 hkn hp hq
  have hbound : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * term n p q k := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), term n p q j := hsum.symm
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ range (n + 1), term n p q k :=
          sum_le_sum fun j hj => hmax j (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega)
      _ = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * term n p q k := by
          rw [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          ring
  unfold term at hbound
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * q ^ (n - k)) := hbound
    _ = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * q ^ (n - k) := by ring

name: EOC.BinomialEntropy.le_choose
statement:
theorem le_choose (n k : ℕ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) :
    ((n : ℝ) / k) ^ k * ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - k)) ^ (n - k) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
      ≤ (n.choose k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := cast_pos n k hk0 hkn
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hnk : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) - k := by
    have : (k : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hkn
    linarith
  have hbase := one_le_succ_mul_choose_mul n k hk0 hkn
  have hA : ((k : ℝ) / n) ^ k = 1 / ((n : ℝ) / k) ^ k := by
    rw [one_div, ← inv_pow]
    congr 1
    rw [inv_div]
  have hB : (((n : ℝ) - k) / n) ^ (n - k) = 1 / ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - k)) ^ (n - k) := by
    rw [one_div, ← inv_pow]
    congr 1
    rw [inv_div]
  rw [hA, hB] at hbase
  have hP : (0 : ℝ) < ((n : ℝ) / k) ^ k := by positivity
  have hQ : (0 : ℝ) < ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - k)) ^ (n - k) := by positivity
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1)]
  have hexp : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (n.choose k : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) / k) ^ k) *
      (1 / ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - k)) ^ (n - k))
      = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (n.choose k : ℝ) / (((n : ℝ) / k) ^ k *
        ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - k)) ^ (n - k)) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hexp, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hbase
  nlinarith [hbase, hP, hQ]

name: EOC.q_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem q_zero (d : ℕ → ℕ) : q d 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.q_succ
statement: theorem q_succ (d : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : q d (j + 1) = 3 * q d j + 2 ^ s d j
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.C_zero
statement: theorem C_zero (d : ℕ → ℕ) : C d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold C; simp

name: EOC.factor_mul_sum
statement:
private theorem factor_mul_sum (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    3 * (∑ j ∈ range M, f j) = ∑ j ∈ range M, 3 * f j
proof:
:= by
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ M ih => simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.mul_add, ih]

name: EOC.q_eq_C
statement: theorem q_eq_C (d : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ N, q d N = C d N
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero => rw [q_zero, C_zero]
  | succ N ih =>
    have hshift : 3 * C d N = ∑ j ∈ range N, 3 ^ (N - j) * 2 ^ s d j := by
      unfold C
      rw [factor_mul_sum N (fun j => 3 ^ (N - 1 - j) * 2 ^ s d j)]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
      have hNj : N - j = (N - 1 - j) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hNj, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hC : C d (N + 1) = (∑ j ∈ range N, 3 ^ (N - j) * 2 ^ s d j) + 2 ^ s d N := by
      unfold C
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [q_succ, ih, hshift, hC]

name: EOC.iter_carry_eq
statement:
theorem iter_carry_eq (d : ℕ → ℕ) (m0 N : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ i < N, 2 ^ d i ∣ (3 * iter d m0 i + 1)) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ N → 2 ^ s d j * iter d m0 j = 3 ^ j * m0 + q d j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro _; simp
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hj
    have hiN : i < N := by omega
    have hIH : 2 ^ s d i * iter d m0 i = 3 ^ i * m0 + q d i := ih (le_of_lt hiN)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd i hiN
    have hiter_succ : iter d m0 (i + 1) = k := by
      rw [iter_succ, hk, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left k (by positivity)]
    rw [s_succ, q_succ, pow_add, hiter_succ, pow_succ]
    have step1 : 2 ^ s d i * 2 ^ d i * k = 3 * (2 ^ s d i * iter d m0 i) + 2 ^ s d i := by
      rw [show (2:ℕ) ^ s d i * 2 ^ d i * k = 2 ^ s d i * (2 ^ d i * k) from by ring, ← hk]
      ring
    rw [step1, hIH]
    ring

name: EOC.s_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem s_zero (d : ℕ → ℕ) : s d 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_range_zero d

name: EOC.s_succ
statement: theorem s_succ (d : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : s d (j + 1) = s d j + d j
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_range_succ d j

name: EOC.orbit_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem orbit_zero (m0 : ℕ) : orbit m0 0 = m0
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.orbit_succ
statement: theorem orbit_succ (m0 j : ℕ) : orbit m0 (j + 1) = T (orbit m0 j)
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.iter_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iter_zero (d : ℕ → ℕ) (m0 : ℕ) : iter d m0 0 = m0
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.iter_succ
statement:
theorem iter_succ (d : ℕ → ℕ) (m0 j : ℕ) :
    iter d m0 (j + 1) = (3 * iter d m0 j + 1) / 2 ^ d j
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.orbit_eq_iter_of_orbit_valuation
statement:
theorem orbit_eq_iter_of_orbit_valuation
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N m0 : ℕ) (h : ∀ j < N, a (orbit m0 j) = d j) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ N → orbit m0 j = iter d m0 j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hj
    have hiN : i < N := by omega
    have heq : orbit m0 i = iter d m0 i := ih (le_of_lt hiN)
    have hval : a (orbit m0 i) = d i := h i hiN
    have hval' : a (iter d m0 i) = d i := by rw [← heq]; exact hval
    rw [orbit_succ, iter_succ, heq]
    unfold T
    rw [hval']

name: EOC.orbit_eq_iter_of_iter_valuation
statement:
theorem orbit_eq_iter_of_iter_valuation
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N m0 : ℕ) (h : ∀ j < N, a (iter d m0 j) = d j) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ N → orbit m0 j = iter d m0 j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hj
    have hiN : i < N := by omega
    have heq : orbit m0 i = iter d m0 i := ih (le_of_lt hiN)
    have hval' : a (iter d m0 i) = d i := h i hiN
    rw [orbit_succ, iter_succ, heq]
    unfold T
    rw [hval']

name: EOC.realizes_iff_iter_valuation
statement:
theorem realizes_iff_iter_valuation (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N m0 : ℕ) :
    Realizes d N m0 ↔ Odd m0 ∧ ∀ j < N, a (iter d m0 j) = d j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hodd, hval⟩
    refine ⟨hodd, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have heq := orbit_eq_iter_of_orbit_valuation d N m0 hval j (le_of_lt hj)
    rw [← heq]
    exact hval j hj
  · rintro ⟨hodd, hval⟩
    refine ⟨hodd, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have heq := orbit_eq_iter_of_iter_valuation d N m0 hval j (le_of_lt hj)
    rw [heq]
    exact hval j hj

name: EOC.PairValuation.s_eq_of_prefix_agree
statement:
theorem s_eq_of_prefix_agree {d e : ℕ → ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) :
    s d k = s e k
proof:
:= by
  unfold s
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => hagree i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))

name: EOC.PairValuation.q_eq_of_prefix_agree
statement:
theorem q_eq_of_prefix_agree {d e : ℕ → ℕ} :
    ∀ k, (∀ i < k, d i = e i) → q d k = q e k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hagree
    have hagree' : ∀ i < n, d i = e i := fun i hi => hagree i (by omega)
    rw [q_succ, q_succ, ih hagree', s_eq_of_prefix_agree hagree']

name: EOC.PairValuation.q_succ_eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem q_succ_eq_of_agree {d e : ℕ → ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) :
    q d (k + 1) = q e (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_succ, q_succ, q_eq_of_prefix_agree k hagree, s_eq_of_prefix_agree hagree]

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_carry
statement:
theorem orbit_carry (x j : ℕ) :
    2 ^ s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) j * orbit x j
      = 3 ^ j * x + q (fun i => a (orbit x i)) j
proof:
:= by
  have hbridge := orbit_eq_iter_of_orbit_valuation (fun i => a (orbit x i)) j x
    (fun _ _ => rfl)
  have hdvd : ∀ i < j, 2 ^ (fun i => a (orbit x i)) i
      ∣ (3 * iter (fun i => a (orbit x i)) x i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [← hbridge i hi.le]
    exact pow_padicValNat_dvd
  have h := iter_carry_eq (fun i => a (orbit x i)) x j hdvd j le_rfl
  rwa [← hbridge j le_rfl] at h

name: EOC.PairValuation.odd_two_pow_sub_two_pow
statement:
theorem odd_two_pow_sub_two_pow {α β : ℕ} {y y' : ℤ} (hy : Odd y) (hy' : Odd y')
    (hne : α ≠ β) :
    Odd ((2 : ℤ) ^ (β - min α β) * y' - 2 ^ (α - min α β) * y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · have hmin : min α β = α := min_eq_left h.le
    rw [hmin, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul]
    have heven : Even ((2 : ℤ) ^ (β - α) * y') := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, β - α = t + 1 := ⟨β - α - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [ht, pow_succ]
      exact ⟨2 ^ t * y', by ring⟩
    exact heven.sub_odd hy
  · have hmin : min α β = β := min_eq_right h.le
    rw [hmin, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul]
    have heven : Even ((2 : ℤ) ^ (α - β) * y) := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, α - β = t + 1 := ⟨α - β - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [ht, pow_succ]
      exact ⟨2 ^ t * y, by ring⟩
    exact hy'.sub_even heven

name: EOC.PairValuation.padicValInt_two_pow_mul_odd
statement:
theorem padicValInt_two_pow_mul_odd (n : ℕ) {Q : ℤ} (hQ : Odd Q) :
    padicValInt 2 ((2 : ℤ) ^ n * Q) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := by
    have h := Int.odd_iff.mp hQ
    rintro rfl
    simp at h
  have hpow : ((2 : ℤ) ^ n) = ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; rfl
  have hQv : padicValInt 2 Q = 0 := by
    apply padicValInt.eq_zero_of_not_dvd
    intro h2
    exact (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hQ) (even_iff_two_dvd.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h2))
  rw [padicValInt.mul (by positivity) hQ0, hQv, add_zero, hpow, padicValInt.of_nat,
    padicValNat.prime_pow]

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_pair_carry_identity
statement:
theorem orbit_pair_carry_identity (x x' k : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j)) :
    (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * ((x' : ℤ) - x)
      = 2 ^ s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k
        * (2 ^ a (orbit x' k) * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ a (orbit x k) * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := orbit_carry x (k + 1)
  have h2 := orbit_carry x' (k + 1)
  have hq : q (fun i => a (orbit x i)) (k + 1) = q (fun i => a (orbit x' i)) (k + 1) :=
    q_succ_eq_of_agree hagree
  have hs : s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k = s (fun i => a (orbit x' i)) k :=
    s_eq_of_prefix_agree hagree
  rw [s_succ, pow_add] at h1 h2
  rw [hq] at h1
  rw [← hs] at h2
  have h1' : ((2 : ℤ) ^ s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k * 2 ^ a (orbit x k)
      * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ))
      = 3 ^ (k + 1) * (x : ℤ) + (q (fun i => a (orbit x' i)) (k + 1) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have h2' : ((2 : ℤ) ^ s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k * 2 ^ a (orbit x' k)
      * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ))
      = 3 ^ (k + 1) * (x' : ℤ) + (q (fun i => a (orbit x' i)) (k + 1) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h2
  linear_combination h1' - h2'

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_pair_factorization
statement:
theorem orbit_pair_factorization (x x' k : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j))
    (hne : a (orbit x k) ≠ a (orbit x' k)) :
    ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
      (x' : ℤ) - x
        = 2 ^ (s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k + min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k))) * Q ∧
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * Q
        = 2 ^ (a (orbit x' k) - min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k))) * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ (a (orbit x k) - min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k)))
            * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set A := a (orbit x k) with hA
  set B := a (orbit x' k) with hB
  set Sk := s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k with hSk
  set m := min A B with hm
  set Q0 : ℤ := 2 ^ (B - m) * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ) - 2 ^ (A - m) * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ)
    with hQ0
  have hy : Odd ((orbit x (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [orbit_succ]; exact (T_odd _).natCast
  have hy' : Odd ((orbit x' (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [orbit_succ]; exact (T_odd _).natCast
  have hQ0odd : Odd Q0 := odd_two_pow_sub_two_pow hy hy' hne
  
  have hbracket : (2 : ℤ) ^ B * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ) - 2 ^ A * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ)
      = 2 ^ m * Q0 := by
    have hAm : A = m + (A - m) := by omega
    have hBm : B = m + (B - m) := by omega
    rw [hQ0]
    conv_lhs => rw [hBm, hAm]
    rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    ring
  have hid := orbit_pair_carry_identity x x' k hagree
  rw [← hA, ← hB, ← hSk, hbracket, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add] at hid
  
  have hcop : IsCoprime ((3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1)) ((2 : ℤ) ^ (Sk + m)) := by
    apply IsCoprime.pow
    rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
    rfl
  have hdvd : (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) ∣ Q0 :=
    hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ⟨(x' : ℤ) - x, hid.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hdvd
  refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hQ] at hQ0odd
    exact (Int.odd_mul.mp hQ0odd).2
  · have h3 : (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ h3
    rw [hid, hQ]
    ring
  · exact hQ.symm

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_pair_valuation
statement:
theorem orbit_pair_valuation (x x' k : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j))
    (hne : a (orbit x k) ≠ a (orbit x' k)) :
    padicValInt 2 ((x' : ℤ) - x)
      = s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k + min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQodd, hfac, -⟩ := orbit_pair_factorization x x' k hagree hne
  rw [hfac]
  exact padicValInt_two_pow_mul_odd _ hQodd

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_data_of_realizes
statement:
private theorem orbit_data_of_realizes {d e : ℕ → ℕ} {k x x' : ℕ}
    (hx : Realizes d (k + 1) x) (hx' : Realizes e (k + 1) x')
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) :
    (∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j)) ∧
    s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k = S d k ∧
    a (orbit x k) = d k ∧ a (orbit x' k) = e k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, ?_, hx.2 k (by omega), hx'.2 k (by omega)⟩
  · rw [hx.2 j (by omega), hx'.2 j (by omega), hagree j hj]
  · exact s_eq_of_prefix_agree (fun i hi => hx.2 i (by omega))

name: EOC.PairValuation.realizes_pair_factorization
statement:
theorem realizes_pair_factorization (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (k x x' : ℕ)
    (hx : Realizes d (k + 1) x) (hx' : Realizes e (k + 1) x')
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
      (x' : ℤ) - x = 2 ^ (S d k + min (d k) (e k)) * Q ∧
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * Q
        = 2 ^ (e k - min (d k) (e k)) * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ (d k - min (d k) (e k)) * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hag, hs, hak, hak'⟩ := orbit_data_of_realizes hx hx' hagree
  have h := orbit_pair_factorization x x' k hag (by rw [hak, hak']; exact hne)
  rwa [hs, hak, hak'] at h

name: EOC.PairValuation.realizes_pair_valuation
statement:
theorem realizes_pair_valuation (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (k x x' : ℕ)
    (hx : Realizes d (k + 1) x) (hx' : Realizes e (k + 1) x')
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    padicValInt 2 ((x' : ℤ) - x) = S d k + min (d k) (e k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQodd, hfac, -⟩ := realizes_pair_factorization d e k x x' hx hx' hagree hne
  rw [hfac]
  exact padicValInt_two_pow_mul_odd _ hQodd

name: EOC.PairValuation.realizes_pair_quotient_valuation
statement:
theorem realizes_pair_quotient_valuation (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (k x x' : ℕ)
    (hx : Realizes d (k + 1) x) (hx' : Realizes e (k + 1) x')
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ (S d k + 1) ∣ ((x' : ℤ) - x) ∧
    padicValInt 2 (((x' : ℤ) - x) / 2 ^ (S d k + 1)) = min (d k) (e k) - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQodd, hfac, -⟩ := realizes_pair_factorization d e k x x' hx hx' hagree hne
  have hdk : 1 ≤ d k := by
    rw [← hx.2 k (by omega)]; exact a_pos_of_odd (odd_orbit hx.1 k)
  have hek : 1 ≤ e k := by
    rw [← hx'.2 k (by omega)]; exact a_pos_of_odd (odd_orbit hx'.1 k)
  have hm : 1 ≤ min (d k) (e k) := le_min hdk hek
  have hsplit : (x' : ℤ) - x = 2 ^ (S d k + 1) * (2 ^ (min (d k) (e k) - 1) * Q) := by
    rw [hfac, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    congr 2
    omega
  refine ⟨⟨_, hsplit⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [hsplit, Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by positivity)]
  exact padicValInt_two_pow_mul_odd _ hQodd

name: EOC.PairValuation.realizes_restrict
statement:
private theorem realizes_restrict {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N t x : ℕ} (h : Realizes d N x) (ht : t ≤ N) :
    Realizes d t x
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1, fun j hj => h.2 j (by omega)⟩

name: EOC.PairValuation.leastRealizer_pair_factorization
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_pair_factorization (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N) (hkM : k < M)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he_pos : ∀ i < M, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
      (leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N = 2 ^ (S d k + min (d k) (e k)) * Q ∧
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * Q
        = 2 ^ (e k - min (d k) (e k)) * (orbit (leastRealizer e M) (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ (d k - min (d k) (e k)) * (orbit (leastRealizer d N) (k + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  realizes_pair_factorization d e k _ _
    (realizes_restrict (leastRealizer_realizes d N (by omega) hd_pos) hkN)
    (realizes_restrict (leastRealizer_realizes e M (by omega) he_pos) hkM) hagree hne

name: EOC.PairValuation.leastRealizer_pair_valuation
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_pair_valuation (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N) (hkM : k < M)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he_pos : ∀ i < M, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N) = S d k + min (d k) (e k)
proof:
:=
  realizes_pair_valuation d e k _ _
    (realizes_restrict (leastRealizer_realizes d N (by omega) hd_pos) hkN)
    (realizes_restrict (leastRealizer_realizes e M (by omega) he_pos) hkM) hagree hne

name: EOC.PairValuation.leastRealizer_pair_quotient_valuation
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_pair_quotient_valuation (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N)
    (hkM : k < M) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he_pos : ∀ i < M, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ (S d k + 1) ∣ ((leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N) ∧
    padicValInt 2 (((leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N) / 2 ^ (S d k + 1))
      = min (d k) (e k) - 1
proof:
:=
  realizes_pair_quotient_valuation d e k _ _
    (realizes_restrict (leastRealizer_realizes d N (by omega) hd_pos) hkN)
    (realizes_restrict (leastRealizer_realizes e M (by omega) he_pos) hkM) hagree hne

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pr_zero (f : Nat → Nat) : pr f 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_succ
statement: theorem pr_succ (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : pr f (n + 1) = pr f n * f n
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem prf_zero (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) : prf p f 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_succ
statement:
theorem prf_succ (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    prf p f (n + 1) = prf p f n * (if p n then f n else 1)
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem cnt_zero (p : Nat → Bool) : cnt p 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_succ
statement: theorem cnt_succ (p : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) : cnt p (n + 1) = cnt p n + (if p n then 1 else 0)
proof: := rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_pos
statement: theorem pr_pos (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) : ∀ n, 1 ≤ pr f n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pr_succ]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul ih (hf n)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_pos
statement: theorem prf_pos (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) : ∀ n, 1 ≤ prf p f n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [prf_succ]
    cases hp : p n
    · simpa using ih
    · simp only [ite_true]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul ih (hf n)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_eq_prf_true
statement: theorem pr_eq_prf_true (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ n, pr f n = prf (fun _ => true) f n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pr_succ, prf_succ, ih]; simp

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_add
statement: theorem pr_add (f : Nat → Nat) (j : Nat) : ∀ t, pr f (j + t) = pr f j * pr (fun i => f (j + i)) t
proof:
:= by
  intro t; induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [show j + (t + 1) = (j + t) + 1 from by omega, pr_succ, ih, pr_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_le_pr
statement: theorem pr_le_pr (f g : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (h : ∀ i, i < n → f i ≤ g i) : pr f n ≤ pr g n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pr_succ, pr_succ]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (ih (fun i hi => h i (by omega))) (h n (by omega))

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.ite_or_split
statement:
theorem ite_or_split (b c : Bool) (x : Nat) (h : ¬ (b = true ∧ c = true)) :
    (if (b || c) then x else 1) = (if b then x else 1) * (if c then x else 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ h

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.ite_or_add
statement:
theorem ite_or_add (b c : Bool) (h : ¬ (b = true ∧ c = true)) :
    (if (b || c) then 1 else 0) = (if b then 1 else 0) + (if c then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ h

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.decide_split
statement:
theorem decide_split (P Q R : Prop) [Decidable P] [Decidable Q] [Decidable R] (h : P ↔ Q ∨ R) :
    decide P = (decide Q || decide R)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : Q <;> by_cases hr : R <;> simp [hq, hr, h]

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_of_false
statement:
theorem prf_of_false (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → p i = false) → prf p f n = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    rw [prf_succ, ih (fun i hi => h i (by omega)), h n (by omega)]
    simp

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_split
statement:
theorem prf_split (p q r : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat)
    (hpqr : ∀ i, p i = (q i || r i)) (hdisj : ∀ i, ¬ (q i = true ∧ r i = true)) :
    ∀ n, prf p f n = prf q f n * prf r f n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [prf_succ, prf_succ, prf_succ, ih, hpqr n, ite_or_split _ _ _ (hdisj n)]
    ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_split
statement:
theorem cnt_split (p q r : Nat → Bool)
    (hpqr : ∀ i, p i = (q i || r i)) (hdisj : ∀ i, ¬ (q i = true ∧ r i = true)) :
    ∀ n, cnt p n = cnt q n + cnt r n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [cnt_succ, cnt_succ, cnt_succ, ih, hpqr n, ite_or_add _ _ (hdisj n)]
    omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_le
statement: theorem cnt_le (p : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n, cnt p n ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [cnt_succ]; cases p n <;> simp <;> omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_of_false
statement: theorem cnt_of_false (p : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → p i = false) → cnt p n = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    rw [cnt_succ, ih (fun i hi => h i (by omega)), h n (by omega)]
    simp

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_of_true
statement: theorem cnt_of_true (p : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → p i = true) → cnt p n = n
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    rw [cnt_succ, ih (fun i hi => h i (by omega)), h n (by omega)]
    simp

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_eq_le_one
statement:
theorem cnt_eq_le_one (m : Nat → Nat) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (b : Nat) :
    ∀ n, cnt (fun i => decide (m i = b)) n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [cnt_succ]
    by_cases hb : m n = b
    · have hzero : cnt (fun i => decide (m i = b)) n = 0 := by
        apply cnt_of_false
        intro i hi
        have : m i ≠ b := fun h => by
          have := hinj i n (h.trans hb.symm); omega
        simp [this]
      rw [hzero]; simp [hb]
    · simp [hb]; exact ih

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_range_le
statement:
theorem cnt_range_le (m : Nat → Nat) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (a : Nat) :
    ∀ b n, cnt (fun i => decide (a ≤ m i ∧ m i < b)) n ≤ b - a
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero =>
    intro n
    rw [cnt_of_false]
    · simp
    · intro i _; apply decide_eq_false; omega
  | succ b ih =>
    intro n
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge b a with hab | hab
    · rw [cnt_of_false]
      · simp
      · intro i _; apply decide_eq_false; omega
    · have hsplit := cnt_split
        (fun i => decide (a ≤ m i ∧ m i < b + 1))
        (fun i => decide (a ≤ m i ∧ m i < b))
        (fun i => decide (m i = b))
        (fun i => decide_split _ _ _ (by omega))
        (fun i => by simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) n
      rw [hsplit]
      have h1 := ih n
      have h2 := cnt_eq_le_one m hinj b n
      omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.bernoulli_upper
statement: theorem bernoulli_upper (A : Nat) : ∀ k, (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) ≤ A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  intro k; induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hmul : (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (A + 1) ≤ (A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ k) * (A + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ih
    have hAle : A ^ (k + 1) ≤ (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ A) _
    have e : (A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ k) * (A + 1)
        = A ^ (k + 1 + 1) + A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.pow_succ]
    rw [Nat.pow_succ (A + 1) (k + 1)]
    calc (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (A + 1)
        ≤ A ^ (k + 1 + 1) + A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by rw [← e]; exact hmul
      _ ≤ A ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
          have := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add_left hAle (A ^ (k + 1 + 1))) ((k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ (k + 1))
          exact this
      _ = A ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (k + 1 + 1) * (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [Nat.succ_mul (k + 1)]; omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.two_pow_le_three_pred_pow
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_three_pred_pow (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    2 * (3 * n) ^ n ≤ 3 * (3 * n - 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A, 3 * n = A + 1 := ⟨3 * n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hA' : 3 * n - 1 = A := by omega
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [hA', hA]
  have hb := bernoulli_upper A k
  
  have h3 : 3 * ((k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ k) = (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.mul_assoc, show 3 * (k + 1) = A + 1 from by omega, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [hk] at *
  
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hb
  rw [Nat.mul_add, h3] at this
  omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prod_pm_le
statement:
theorem prod_pm_le (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (3 * n + 1) ^ n * (3 * n - 1) ^ n ≤ (3 * n) ^ n * (3 * n) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.mul_pow]
  apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A, 3 * n = A + 1 := ⟨3 * n - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [show 3 * n - 1 = A from by omega, hA]
  
  have : (A + 1 + 1) * A = A * A + 2 * A := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_mul]; omega
  rw [this]
  have : (A + 1) * (A + 1) = A * A + 2 * A + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add]; omega
  rw [this]; omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.two_pow_succ_le
statement: theorem two_pow_succ_le (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ n ≤ 3 * (3 * n) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < 3 * (3 * n - 1) ^ n := by
    apply Nat.mul_pos (by decide)
    apply Nat.pow_pos; omega
  apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right _ hpos
  
  calc 2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ n * (3 * (3 * n - 1) ^ n)
      = (2 * 3) * ((3 * n + 1) ^ n * (3 * n - 1) ^ n) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ (2 * 3) * ((3 * n) ^ n * (3 * n) ^ n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (prod_pm_le n hn)
    _ = 3 * (3 * n) ^ n * (2 * (3 * n) ^ n) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ 3 * (3 * n) ^ n * (3 * (3 * n - 1) ^ n) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (two_pow_le_three_pred_pow n hn)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.two_pow_le_of_le
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_of_le (n t : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ht : t ≤ n) :
    2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ t ≤ 3 * (3 * n) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, n = t + u := ⟨n - t, by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < (3 * n) ^ u := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right _ hpos
  have h := two_pow_succ_le n hn
  calc 2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ t * (3 * n) ^ u
      ≤ 2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ t * (3 * n + 1) ^ u := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left; apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left; omega
    _ = 2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ n := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_add, ← hu]
    _ ≤ 3 * (3 * n) ^ n := h
    _ = 3 * (3 * n) ^ t * (3 * n) ^ u := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_add, ← hu]

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_level_termwise
statement:
theorem prf_level_termwise (m : Nat → Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ N, (∀ i, i < N → p i = true → n ≤ m i) →
      prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N
        ≤ prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * n + 1) ^ cnt p N
proof:
:= by
  intro N; induction N with
  | zero => intro _; simp
  | succ N ih =>
    intro h
    have ih' := ih (fun i hi hp => h i (by omega) hp)
    rw [prf_succ, prf_succ, cnt_succ]
    cases hp : p N
    · simpa using ih'
    · have hnm := h N (by omega) hp
      
      have hterm : (3 * m N + 1) * (3 * n) ≤ 3 * m N * (3 * n + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
        have : 3 * n ≤ 3 * m N := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hnm
        omega
      calc prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N * (3 * m N + 1) * ((3 * n) ^ cnt p N * (3 * n))
          = (prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N) * ((3 * m N + 1) * (3 * n)) := by ac_rfl
        _ ≤ (prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * n + 1) ^ cnt p N) * (3 * m N * (3 * n + 1)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul ih' hterm
        _ = prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * m N) * ((3 * n + 1) ^ cnt p N * (3 * n + 1)) := by ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_level_bound
statement:
theorem prf_level_bound (m : Nat → Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (n N : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hlow : ∀ i, i < N → p i = true → n ≤ m i) (hcnt : cnt p N ≤ n) :
    2 * prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N ≤ 3 * prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (3 * n) ^ cnt p N := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right _ hpos
  have h1 := prf_level_termwise m p n N hlow
  have h2 := two_pow_le_of_le n (cnt p N) hn hcnt
  calc 2 * prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N
      = 2 * (prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ 2 * (prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * n + 1) ^ cnt p N) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h1
    _ = prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ cnt p N) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h2
    _ = 3 * prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N := by ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.dyadic_chain
statement:
theorem dyadic_chain (m : Nat → Nat) (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (N : Nat) :
    ∀ k, 2 ^ k * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N
        ≤ 3 ^ k * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N
proof:
:= by
  intro k; induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hf : ∀ i, i < N → decide (m i < 2 ^ 0) = false := by
      intro i _; have := hm i; apply decide_eq_false; omega
    have e1 : prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ 0)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N = 1 :=
      prf_of_false _ _ N hf
    have e2 : prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ 0)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N = 1 :=
      prf_of_false _ _ N hf
    rw [e1, e2]; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    
    have hsplitF := prf_split
      (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ (k + 1)))
      (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k))
      (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1)))
      (fun i => 3 * m i + 1)
      (fun i => decide_split _ _ _ (by omega))
      (fun i => by simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) N
    have hsplitG := prf_split
      (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ (k + 1)))
      (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k))
      (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1)))
      (fun i => 3 * m i)
      (fun i => decide_split _ _ _ (by omega))
      (fun i => by simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) N
    have hlevel := prf_level_bound m (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1))) (2 ^ k) N
      (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))
      (by intro i _ hp; simp at hp; exact hp.1)
      (by
        have := cnt_range_le m hinj (2 ^ k) (2 ^ (k + 1)) N
        rw [Nat.pow_succ] at this ⊢
        omega)
    rw [hsplitF, hsplitG, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_succ]
    calc 2 ^ k * 2 * (prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N
              * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1))) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N)
        = (2 ^ k * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N)
            * (2 * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1))) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N) := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ (3 ^ k * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N)
            * (3 * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1))) (fun i => 3 * m i) N) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul ih hlevel
      _ = 3 ^ k * 3 * (prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N
              * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ k ≤ m i ∧ m i < 2 ^ (k + 1))) (fun i => 3 * m i) N) := by ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.packing_bound
statement:
theorem packing_bound (m : Nat → Nat) (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j)
    (N L : Nat) (hNL : N ≤ 2 ^ L) :
    2 ^ (L + 1) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N ≤ 3 ^ (L + 1) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr_eq_prf_true, pr_eq_prf_true]
  have hsplitF := prf_split (fun _ => true)
    (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ L)) (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i))
    (fun i => 3 * m i + 1)
    (fun i => by rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (m i) (2 ^ L) with h | h <;> simp [h])
    (fun i => by simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) N
  have hsplitG := prf_split (fun _ => true)
    (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ L)) (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i))
    (fun i => 3 * m i)
    (fun i => by rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (m i) (2 ^ L) with h | h <;> simp [h])
    (fun i => by simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) N
  have hchain := dyadic_chain m hm hinj N L
  have htail := prf_level_bound m (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i)) (2 ^ L) N
    (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))
    (by intro i _ hp; simpa using hp)
    (Nat.le_trans (cnt_le _ N) hNL)
  rw [hsplitF, hsplitG, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_succ]
  calc 2 ^ L * 2 * (prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ L)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N
          * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N)
      = (2 ^ L * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ L)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N)
          * (2 * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ (3 ^ L * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ L)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N)
          * (3 * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul hchain htail
    _ = 3 ^ L * 3 * (prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ L)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N
          * prf (fun i => decide (2 ^ L ≤ m i)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N) := by ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.orbit_product_identity
statement:
theorem orbit_product_identity (m d : Nat → Nat)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 2 ^ d i * m (i + 1) = 3 * m i + 1) :
    ∀ j, 2 ^ sr d j * m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j = 3 ^ j * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j
proof:
:= by
  intro j; induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [sr_succ, pr_succ, pr_succ, Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_succ]
    calc 2 ^ sr d j * 2 ^ d j * m (j + 1) * (pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * (3 * m j))
        = (2 ^ sr d j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j) * (2 ^ d j * m (j + 1)) * (3 * m j) := by ac_rfl
      _ = (2 ^ sr d j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j) * (3 * m j + 1) * (3 * m j) := by rw [hstep j]
      _ = (2 ^ sr d j * m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j) * (3 * (3 * m j + 1)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = (3 ^ j * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j) * (3 * (3 * m j + 1)) := by rw [ih]
      _ = 3 ^ j * 3 * m 0 * (pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j * (3 * m j + 1)) := by ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.state_bound
statement:
theorem state_bound (m d : Nat → Nat) (G : Nat)
    (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 2 ^ d i * m (i + 1) = 3 * m i + 1)
    (hlow : ∀ j, 3 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ G * 2 ^ sr d j)
    (N L : Nat) (hNL : N ≤ 2 ^ L) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ N → m j * 2 ^ (L + 1) ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 * 3 ^ (L + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  have hid := orbit_product_identity m d hstep j
  have hQj : 1 ≤ pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j := pr_pos _ (fun i => by have := hm i; omega) j
  have hQN : 1 ≤ pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N := pr_pos _ (fun i => by have := hm i; omega) N
  have h2S : 1 ≤ 2 ^ sr d j := Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
  
  have h1 : m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j := by
    apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ h2S
    calc 2 ^ sr d j * (m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j)
        = 3 ^ j * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j := by rw [← hid]; ac_rfl
      _ ≤ (2 ^ G * 2 ^ sr d j) * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hlow j))
      _ = 2 ^ sr d j * (2 ^ G * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j) := by ac_rfl
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, N = j + t := ⟨N - j, by omega⟩
  have h2 : pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N
      ≤ pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N := by
    rw [ht, pr_add, pr_add]
    have hle : pr (fun i => 3 * m (j + i)) t ≤ pr (fun i => 3 * m (j + i) + 1) t :=
      pr_le_pr _ _ t (fun i _ => Nat.le_succ _)
    calc pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j * (pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m (j + i)) t)
        = (pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j) * pr (fun i => 3 * m (j + i)) t := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ (pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j) * pr (fun i => 3 * m (j + i) + 1) t :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hle
      _ = pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * (pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m (j + i) + 1) t) := by ac_rfl
  
  have h3 : m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N := by
    apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hQj
    calc pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * (m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N)
        = (m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ (2 ^ G * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h1
      _ = 2 ^ G * m 0 * (pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N) := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 * (pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h2
      _ = pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j * (2 ^ G * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N) := by ac_rfl
  
  have hpack := packing_bound m hm hinj N L hNL
  apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hQN
  calc pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (m j * 2 ^ (L + 1))
      = (m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N) * 2 ^ (L + 1) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ (2 ^ G * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N) * 2 ^ (L + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h3
    _ = 2 ^ G * m 0 * (2 ^ (L + 1) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 * (3 ^ (L + 1) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hpack
    _ = pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (2 ^ G * m 0 * 3 ^ (L + 1)) := by ac_rfl

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pigeonhole
statement:
theorem pigeonhole (m : Nat → Nat) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (N X : Nat)
    (h : ∀ j, j < N → 1 ≤ m j ∧ m j ≤ X) : N ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  have hall : cnt (fun i => decide (1 ≤ m i ∧ m i < X + 1)) N = N := by
    apply cnt_of_true
    intro i hi; have := h i hi; simp; omega
  have := cnt_range_le m hinj 1 (X + 1) N
  omega

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.no_injective_orbit_of_lower_drift
statement:
theorem no_injective_orbit_of_lower_drift (m d : Nat → Nat) (G : Nat)
    (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 2 ^ d i * m (i + 1) = 3 * m i + 1)
    (hlow : ∀ j, 3 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ G * 2 ^ sr d j) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 1 ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) (hm 0)
  
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C, C = 2 ^ G * m 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, 9 * C = k + 1 := ⟨9 * C - 1, by omega⟩
  have hsb := state_bound m d G hm hinj hstep hlow (2 ^ (k + 1)) (k + 1) (Nat.le_refl _)
  have hX : ∀ j, j < 2 ^ (k + 1) → 1 ≤ m j ∧ m j ≤ C * 3 ^ (k + 1 + 1) / 2 ^ (k + 1 + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    refine ⟨hm j, ?_⟩
    have := hsb j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    rw [← hCdef] at this
    exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))).2 this
  have hpig := pigeonhole m hinj (2 ^ (k + 1)) _ hX
  have hmul : 2 ^ (k + 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1 + 1) ≤ C * 3 ^ (k + 1 + 1) :=
    Nat.le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hpig) (Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _)
  
  have hbern := bernoulli_nat 3 k
  have h4 : 2 ^ (k + 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1 + 1) = 2 * ((2 * 2) ^ (k + 1)) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_pow, Nat.pow_succ 2 (k + 1)]; ac_rfl
  have h3a : 3 ^ (k + 1) = 3 ^ k * 3 := Nat.pow_succ 3 k
  have h3b : 3 ^ (k + 1 + 1) = 3 ^ k * 9 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
  rw [h4] at hmul
  rw [h3a] at hbern
  rw [h3b] at hmul
  
  have hcomb : 2 * (3 ^ k * 3 + (k + 1) * 3 ^ k) ≤ C * (3 ^ k * 9) :=
    Nat.le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hbern) hmul
  have hpos : 0 < 3 ^ k := Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
  
  have hdiv : (2 * 3 + 2 * (k + 1)) * 3 ^ k ≤ (9 * C) * 3 ^ k := by
    calc (2 * 3 + 2 * (k + 1)) * 3 ^ k = 2 * (3 ^ k * 3 + (k + 1) * 3 ^ k) := by
          have e := Nat.mul_add 2 (3 ^ k * 3) ((k + 1) * 3 ^ k)
          rw [e, Nat.add_mul]; ac_rfl
      _ ≤ C * (3 ^ k * 9) := hcomb
      _ = (9 * C) * 3 ^ k := by ac_rfl
  have := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hdiv hpos
  omega

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.sum_T
statement: theorem sum_T (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), T n k j = n ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_pow k (n - k) n
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk] at h
  rw [h]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by unfold T; rw [Nat.cast_id]; ring

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.choose_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem choose_mul_pow_le (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) ≤ n ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_T n k hk]
  exact single_le_sum (f := T n k) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk))

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_succ
statement:
theorem T_succ (n k j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) :
    T n k (j + 1) * ((j + 1) * (n - k)) = T n k j * ((n - j) * k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold T
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, n - j = m + 1 := ⟨n - j - 1, by omega⟩
  have hm' : n - (j + 1) = m := by omega
  have hc := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq n j
  rw [hm] at hc
  rw [hm', hm]
  calc n.choose (j + 1) * k ^ (j + 1) * (n - k) ^ m * ((j + 1) * (n - k))
      = (n.choose (j + 1) * (j + 1)) * (k ^ j * k) * ((n - k) ^ m * (n - k)) := by ring
    _ = (n.choose j * (m + 1)) * (k ^ j * k) * ((n - k) ^ m * (n - k)) := by rw [hc]
    _ = n.choose j * k ^ j * (n - k) ^ (m + 1) * ((m + 1) * k) := by ring

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_succ_le
statement: theorem T_succ_le (n k j : ℕ) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hkn : k < n) : T n k (j + 1) ≤ T n k j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < n
  · have h := T_succ n k j hj
    have hpos : 0 < (j + 1) * (n - k) := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos j) (by omega)
    have hle : (n - j) * k ≤ (j + 1) * (n - k) :=
      calc (n - j) * k ≤ (n - k) * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
        _ ≤ (n - k) * (j + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
        _ = (j + 1) * (n - k) := by ring
    have hmul : T n k (j + 1) * ((j + 1) * (n - k)) ≤ T n k j * ((j + 1) * (n - k)) := by
      rw [h]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hle
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul hpos
  · have h0 : n.choose (j + 1) = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
    simp [T, h0]

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_le_succ
statement: theorem T_le_succ (n k j : ℕ) (hjk : j < k) (hkn : k ≤ n) : T n k j ≤ T n k (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : j < n := by omega
  by_cases hnk : n - k = 0
  · have hne : n - j ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [T, hnk, zero_pow hne]
  · have h := T_succ n k j hj
    have hpos : 0 < (j + 1) * (n - k) := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos j) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnk)
    have hle : (j + 1) * (n - k) ≤ (n - j) * k :=
      calc (j + 1) * (n - k) ≤ k * (n - k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
        _ ≤ k * (n - j) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
        _ = (n - j) * k := by ring
    have hmul : T n k j * ((j + 1) * (n - k)) ≤ T n k (j + 1) * ((j + 1) * (n - k)) := by
      rw [h]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hle
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul hpos

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_le_T_self
statement: theorem T_le_T_self (n k j : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : T n k j ≤ T n k k
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt j k with hjk | hkj
  · have key : ∀ d, d ≤ k → T n k (k - d) ≤ T n k k := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero => intro _; simp
      | succ d ih =>
          intro hd
          calc T n k (k - (d + 1)) ≤ T n k (k - (d + 1) + 1) := T_le_succ n k _ (by omega) hk
            _ = T n k (k - d) := by congr 1; omega
            _ ≤ T n k k := ih (by omega)
    simpa [Nat.sub_sub_self hjk] using key (k - j) (by omega)
  · have key : ∀ d, T n k (k + d) ≤ T n k k := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero => simp
      | succ d ih =>
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hk with hkn | hkn
          · exact (T_succ_le n k (k + d) (by omega) hkn).trans ih
          · have h0 : n.choose (k + (d + 1)) = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
            simp [T, h0]
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hkj.le] using key (j - k)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.pow_le_succ_mul_choose_mul_pow
statement:
theorem pow_le_succ_mul_choose_mul_pow (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    n ^ n ≤ (n + 1) * (n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_T n k hk]
  calc ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), T n k j ≤ ∑ _j ∈ range (n + 1), T n k k :=
        sum_le_sum fun j _ => T_le_T_self n k j hk
    _ = (n + 1) * T n k k := by simp
    _ = (n + 1) * (n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k)) := by unfold T; rfl

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.self_pow_pos
statement: theorem self_pow_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < k ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · simp
  · exact pow_pos hk k

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.cast_prod_pos
statement:
theorem cast_prod_pos (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (0 : ℝ) < ((n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.choose_pos hk) (self_pow_pos k))
    (self_pow_pos (n - k))

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_prod
statement:
theorem log_prod (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    log ((n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      log (n.choose k) + k * log k + ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * log ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((n.choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos hk).ne'
  have h2 : ((k ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (self_pow_pos k).ne'
  have h3 : (((n - k) ^ (n - k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (self_pow_pos (n - k)).ne'
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_mul (mul_ne_zero h1 h2) h3, Real.log_mul h1 h2,
    Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_choose_le_ent
statement: theorem log_choose_le_ent (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : log (n.choose k) ≤ ent n k
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ((n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((n ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast choose_mul_pow_le n k hk
  have h := Real.log_le_log (cast_prod_pos n k hk) hle
  rw [log_prod n k hk, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow] at h
  unfold ent
  linarith

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.ent_le_log_succ_add_log_choose
statement:
theorem ent_le_log_succ_add_log_choose (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ent n k ≤ log ((n : ℝ) + 1) + log (n.choose k)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ((n ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (((n + 1) * (n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k)) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast pow_le_succ_mul_choose_mul_pow n k hk
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast self_pow_pos n
  have h := Real.log_le_log hpos hle
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_mul (by positivity) (cast_prod_pos n k hk).ne', log_prod n k hk,
    Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow] at h
  push_cast at h
  unfold ent
  linarith

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.one_le_W
statement: theorem one_le_W (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) : 1 ≤ W c N
proof:
:= by
  have h := (collatz_capacity_sandwich c hN).2.1
  have hc : 0 < Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N := Nat.choose_pos (le_collatzBarrier c N)
  change 1 ≤ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c)).card
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c)).card with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0] at h
    omega
  · exact h0

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_W_le
statement:
theorem log_W_le (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    log (W c N) ≤ ent (collatzBarrier c N) N
proof:
:= by
  have hW : (0 : ℝ) < W c N := by exact_mod_cast one_le_W c hN
  calc log (W c N) ≤ log (Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N) :=
        Real.log_le_log hW (by exact_mod_cast card_confinedWords_le_choose hN _)
    _ ≤ ent (collatzBarrier c N) N := log_choose_le_ent _ _ (le_collatzBarrier c N)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_W_ge
statement:
theorem log_W_ge (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ent (collatzBarrier c N) N - log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) - log N ≤ log (W c N)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : (0 : ℝ) < W c N := by exact_mod_cast one_le_W c hN
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos (le_collatzBarrier c N)
  have h1 := ent_le_log_succ_add_log_choose _ _ (le_collatzBarrier c N)
  have h2 : log (Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N) ≤ log N + log (W c N) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul hNr.ne' hW.ne']
    exact Real.log_le_log hC (by exact_mod_cast (collatz_capacity_sandwich c hN).2.1)
  linarith

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.f_continuous
statement: theorem f_continuous : Continuous f
proof:
:=
  continuous_mul_log.sub (continuous_mul_log.comp (continuous_sub_right 1))

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.ent_eq_mul_f
statement:
theorem ent_eq_mul_f {s N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hNs : N ≤ s) :
    ent s N = N * f ((s : ℝ) / N)
proof:
:= by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  unfold ent f
  have hsub : ((s - N : ℕ) : ℝ) = (s : ℝ) - N := by push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hNs]; ring
  rw [hsub]
  have hq : (s : ℝ) / N - 1 = ((s : ℝ) - N) / N := by field_simp
  rw [hq]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hNs with heq | hlt
  · subst heq
    simp
  · have hsN : (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) - N := by
      have : (N : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hlt
      linarith
    have hs : (0 : ℝ) < s := by linarith
    rw [Real.log_div hs.ne' hNr.ne', Real.log_div hsN.ne' hNr.ne']
    field_simp
    ring

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.tendsto_barrier_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_barrier_div (c : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) / N) atTop (𝓝 alpha)
proof:
:= by
  have hlo : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => alpha + ((c : ℝ) - 1) / N) atTop (𝓝 alpha) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat ((c : ℝ) - 1))
  have hhi : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => alpha + (c : ℝ) / N) atTop (𝓝 alpha) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (c : ℝ))
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlo hhi ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
    have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hfl := Nat.sub_one_lt_floor ((N : ℝ) * alpha + c)
    unfold collatzBarrier
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hNr]
    rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hNr.ne']
    linarith
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
    have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hfl := Nat.floor_le (barrier_arg_nonneg c N)
    unfold collatzBarrier
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hNr, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hNr.ne']
    linarith

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.tendsto_log_nat_div
statement: theorem tendsto_log_nat_div : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => log (N : ℝ) / N) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop 1 0 1 one_ne_zero).comp
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  refine h.congr fun N => ?_
  simp

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.tendsto_log_card_confined
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_card_confined (c : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => log (W c N) / N) atTop (𝓝 (f alpha))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => f ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) / N)) atTop (𝓝 (f alpha)) :=
    (f_continuous.tendsto alpha).comp (tendsto_barrier_div c)
  
  have herr : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) + log N) / N) atTop
      (𝓝 0) := by
    have hdom : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => log (alpha + c + 1) / N + 2 * (log (N : ℝ) / N)) atTop
        (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (log (alpha + c + 1))).add
        (tendsto_log_nat_div.const_mul 2)
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hdom ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
      have hNr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
      have h1 : 0 ≤ log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by have := (Nat.cast_nonneg (collatzBarrier c N) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ _); linarith)
      have h2 : 0 ≤ log (N : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hNr
      positivity
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
      have hNr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
      have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by linarith
      have hsN : (collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (alpha + c + 1) * N := by
        have hfl := Nat.floor_le (barrier_arg_nonneg c N)
        unfold collatzBarrier
        have hc : (c : ℝ) ≤ c * N := by nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg c : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c)]
        nlinarith
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hlog : log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) ≤ log (alpha + c + 1) + log N := by
        rw [← Real.log_mul (by have := alpha_pos; positivity) hN0.ne']
        exact Real.log_le_log hpos hsN
      have hr : log (alpha + c + 1) / N + 2 * (log (N : ℝ) / N) =
          (log (alpha + c + 1) + 2 * log N) / N := by ring
      rw [hr]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hN0.le
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' (by simpa using hf.sub herr) hf ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
    have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have h := log_W_ge c hN
    rw [ent_eq_mul_f hN (le_collatzBarrier c N)] at h
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hNr]
    have hexp : (f ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) / N) -
        (log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) + log N) / N) * N =
        N * f ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) / N) - log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) - log N := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hexp]
    linarith
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
    have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have h := log_W_le c hN
    rw [ent_eq_mul_f hN (le_collatzBarrier c N)] at h
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hNr]
    linarith

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.alpha_entropy_eq
statement: theorem alpha_entropy_eq : f alpha = alpha * Real.binEntropy alpha⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 1 < alpha := one_lt_alpha
  have ha0 : alpha ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have ha1 : alpha - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  unfold f Real.binEntropy
  rw [inv_inv, show 1 - alpha⁻¹ = (alpha - 1) / alpha by field_simp, inv_div,
    Real.log_div ha0 ha1]
  field_simp
  ring

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.gS_nonneg
statement: theorem gS_nonneg (j0 N σ S : ℕ) : 0 ≤ gS b j0 N σ S
proof: := Nat.cast_nonneg _

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.norm_Gsuf_le_gS
statement: theorem norm_Gsuf_le_gS (m j0 N σ S lam : ℕ) : ‖Gsuf b m j0 N σ S lam‖ ≤ gS b j0 N σ S
proof:
:=
  norm_Gsuf_le b m j0 N σ S lam

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.sum_sq_split_le_aligned
statement:
theorem sum_sq_split_le_aligned (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), Fpre b m N S (a + k) * Gsuf b m j0 N σ S (a + k)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range H, (∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sum_sq_le_aligned (range H) (range (σ + 1)) (fun k S => Fpre b m N S (a + k))
    (fun k S => Gsuf b m j0 N σ S (a + k)) (gS b j0 N σ)
    (fun k _ S _ => norm_Gsuf_le_gS b m j0 N σ S (a + k))

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.aligned_split_attains
statement:
theorem aligned_split_attains (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ, (∀ k S, ‖c k S‖ = 1) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1),
          Fpre b m N S (a + k) * ((gS b j0 N σ S : ℂ) * c k S)‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑ k ∈ range H, (∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  aligned_attains (range H) (range (σ + 1)) (fun k S => Fpre b m N S (a + k)) (gS b j0 N σ)
    (fun S _ => gS_nonneg b j0 N σ S)

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.norm_aligned_eq
statement:
theorem norm_aligned_eq (j0 N σ S : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ‖(gS b j0 N σ S : ℂ) * z‖ = gS b j0 N σ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, hz, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (gS_nonneg b j0 N σ S)]

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.split_barrier
statement:
theorem split_barrier (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ, (∀ k S, ‖c k S‖ = 1) ∧
      (∑ k ∈ range H, ∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2 ≤
        (range H).card * ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1),
          Fpre b m N S (a + k) * ((gS b j0 N σ S : ℂ) * c k S)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  barrier (range H) (range (σ + 1)) (fun k S => Fpre b m N S (a + k)) (gS b j0 N σ)
    (fun S _ => gS_nonneg b j0 N σ S)

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.path_sq_le_aligned
statement:
theorem path_sq_le_aligned (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNj : N < j0) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ,
        ∏ i ∈ range j0, SwapBound.ee (cp (a + k) m i (P.prefixSum i))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range H, (∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ k, ∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ,
      ∏ i ∈ range j0, SwapBound.ee (cp (a + k) m i (P.prefixSum i)) =
      ∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), Fpre b m N S (a + k) * Gsuf b m j0 N σ S (a + k) :=
    fun k => psi_split b m j0 N σ (a + k) hN1 hNj
  simp_rw [h]
  exact sum_sq_split_le_aligned b m j0 N σ a H

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.card_prefix_sharing
statement:
theorem card_prefix_sharing (j0 σ N : ℕ) :
    (sharePairs (shellP b j0 σ) (fun P => pre N P)).card =
      ∑ c ∈ (shellP b j0 σ).image (fun P => pre N P),
        (fibre (shellP b j0 σ) (fun P => pre N P) c).card ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_sharePairs _ _

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.sq_card_shellP_le_prefix_sharing
statement:
theorem sq_card_shellP_le_prefix_sharing (j0 σ N : ℕ) :
    (shellP b j0 σ).card ^ 2 ≤
      ((shellP b j0 σ).image (fun P => pre N P)).card *
        (sharePairs (shellP b j0 σ) (fun P => pre N P)).card
proof:
:=
  sq_card_le_image_mul_sharePairs _ _

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_fibre_eq_sum_nondvd
statement:
theorem sum_fibre_eq_sum_nondvd {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), F (g + 2 ^ t * k) =
      ∑ lam ∈ (Ico 1 (2 ^ (r + t))).filter (fun lam => ¬ 2 ^ t ∣ lam), F lam
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 0 < 2 ^ t := by positivity
  rw [← sum_product']
  refine sum_nbij' (fun p => p.1 + 2 ^ t * p.2) (fun lam => (lam % 2 ^ t, lam / 2 ^ t))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  · rintro ⟨g, k⟩ hp
    simp only [mem_product, mem_Ico, mem_range] at hp
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Ico]
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : k + 1 ≤ 2 ^ r := hp.2
      have h2 : 2 ^ t * (k + 1) ≤ 2 ^ t * 2 ^ r := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1
      rw [pow_add]; nlinarith [hp.1.2]
    · intro hd
      have : 2 ^ t ∣ g := (Nat.dvd_add_right (dvd_mul_right _ _)).mp (by
        rwa [add_comm] at hd)
      have := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt this hp.1.2
      omega
  · intro lam hl
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Ico] at hl
    simp only [mem_product, mem_Ico, mem_range]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, Nat.mod_lt _ ht⟩, ?_⟩
    · by_contra h0
      exact hl.2 (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (by omega))
    · rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul ht, ← pow_add]; exact hl.1.2
  · rintro ⟨g, k⟩ hp
    simp only [mem_product, mem_Ico, mem_range] at hp
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp.1.2]
    · rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ ht, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hp.1.2, zero_add]
  · intro lam _
    exact Nat.mod_add_div lam (2 ^ t)

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_Ico_one_two_pow
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_two_pow {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ lam ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ n), f lam = ∑ u ∈ range n, ∑ lam ∈ Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1)), f lam
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ, ← ih, sum_Ico_consecutive f Nat.one_le_two_pow
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.le_succ n))]

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_fibre_eq_sum_shells
statement:
theorem sum_fibre_eq_sum_shells {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), F (g + 2 ^ t * k) =
      ∑ u ∈ range (r + t),
        ∑ lam ∈ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).filter (fun lam => ¬ 2 ^ t ∣ lam), F lam
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_fibre_eq_sum_nondvd, sum_filter, sum_Ico_one_two_pow]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun u _ => (sum_filter _ _).symm

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.weightedFourier_lhs_shells
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_lhs_shells (b : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 s σ : ℕ) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ (s - σ)), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ (σ + 1)),
      ‖coef (σ + 1) (s - σ) (g + 2 ^ (s - σ) * k)‖ *
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) (g + 2 ^ (s - σ) * k)‖ ^ 2 =
    ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).filter (fun lam => ¬ 2 ^ (s - σ) ∣ lam),
        ‖coef (σ + 1) (s - σ) lam‖ *
          ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sum_fibre_eq_sum_shells (σ + 1) (s - σ)
    (fun lam => ‖coef (σ + 1) (s - σ) lam‖ *
      ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2)

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.cdist_pos
statement: theorem cdist_pos {r t lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ nondvd r t) : 0 < cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nondvd, mem_filter, mem_Ico] at h
  unfold cdist; omega

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.cdist_lt
statement: theorem cdist_lt {r t lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ nondvd r t) : cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam < 2 ^ (r + t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nondvd, mem_filter, mem_Ico] at h
  unfold cdist; omega

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_nondvd_eq_sum_cshell
statement:
theorem sum_nondvd_eq_sum_cshell {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ lam ∈ nondvd r t, F lam = ∑ u ∈ range (r + t), ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : ∀ lam ∈ nondvd r t, Nat.log 2 (cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam) ∈ range (r + t) := by
    intro lam h
    exact mem_range.mpr (Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (cdist_pos h).ne' (cdist_lt h))
  exact (sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmap F).symm

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.mem_cshell_bounds
statement:
theorem mem_cshell_bounds {r t u lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ cshell r t u) :
    2 ^ u ≤ cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam ∧ cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam < 2 ^ (u + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cshell, mem_filter] at h
  obtain ⟨hn, hlog⟩ := h
  have hpos := cdist_pos hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hpos.ne'
    rwa [hlog] at this
  · have := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num : 1 < 2) (cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam)
    rwa [hlog] at this

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.card_cshell_le
statement: theorem card_cshell_le (r t u : ℕ) : (cshell r t u).card ≤ 2 ^ (u + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set M := 2 ^ (r + t)
  have hsub : cshell r t u ⊆
      Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1)) ∪ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).image (fun x => M - x) := by
    intro lam h
    have hb := mem_cshell_bounds h
    have hlt : lam < M := by
      simp only [cshell, nondvd, mem_filter, mem_Ico] at h; exact h.1.1.2
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Ico, mem_image]
    unfold cdist at hb
    by_cases hc : lam ≤ M - lam
    · left; rw [min_eq_left hc] at hb; exact hb
    · right
      rw [min_eq_right (by omega)] at hb
      exact ⟨M - lam, hb, by omega⟩
  calc (cshell r t u).card
      ≤ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1)) ∪ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).image (fun x => M - x)).card :=
        card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).card +
          ((Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).image (fun x => M - x)).card := card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).card + (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).card :=
        Nat.add_le_add_left card_image_le _
    _ = 2 ^ (u + 1) := by rw [Nat.card_Ico, pow_succ]; omega

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.norm_coef_le_cshell
statement:
theorem norm_coef_le_cshell {r t u lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ cshell r t u) :
    ‖coef r t lam‖ ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : lam ∈ nondvd r t := (mem_filter.mp h).1
  have hI : 1 ≤ lam ∧ lam < 2 ^ (r + t) := by
    simp only [nondvd, mem_filter, mem_Ico] at hn; exact hn.1
  have hb := (mem_cshell_bounds h).1
  have hcast : ((cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam : ℕ) : ℝ) = min (lam : ℝ) (2 ^ (r + t) - lam) := by
    unfold cdist
    rw [Nat.cast_min, Nat.cast_sub hI.2.le]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hbR : (2 : ℝ) ^ u ≤ min (lam : ℝ) (2 ^ (r + t) - lam) := by
    rw [← hcast]; exact_mod_cast hb
  calc ‖coef r t lam‖ ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * min (lam : ℝ) (2 ^ (r + t) - lam)) :=
        norm_coef_le r t lam (by omega) hI.2
    _ ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
        linarith

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ lam, 0 ≤ F lam) (ha : ∀ u, 0 ≤ a u)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (r + t), ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam ≤ (cshell r t u).card * a u) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), ‖coef r t (g + 2 ^ t * k)‖ * F (g + 2 ^ t * k) ≤
      2 ^ t * ∑ u ∈ range (r + t), a u
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_fibre_eq_sum_nondvd r t (fun lam => ‖coef r t lam‖ * F lam)]
  change ∑ lam ∈ nondvd r t, ‖coef r t lam‖ * F lam ≤ _
  rw [sum_nondvd_eq_sum_cshell, mul_sum]
  refine sum_le_sum fun u hu => ?_
  have hw : ∀ lam ∈ cshell r t u, ‖coef r t lam‖ * F lam ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) * F lam :=
    fun lam hl => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_coef_le_cshell hl) (hF lam)
  have hcard : ((cshell r t u).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (u + 1) := by exact_mod_cast card_cshell_le r t u
  have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) := by positivity
  calc ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, ‖coef r t lam‖ * F lam
      ≤ ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) * F lam := sum_le_sum hw
    _ = 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) * ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam := by rw [mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) * ((cshell r t u).card * a u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hshell u hu) hc0
    _ ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u) * (2 ^ (u + 1) * a u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (ha u)) hc0
    _ = 2 ^ t * a u := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.weightedFourier_of_shell_averages
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_shell_averages (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 s σ : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ u, 0 ≤ a u)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u,
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u).card * (a u * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (hfin : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * 2 ^ (s - σ) * ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), a u ≤
      ε ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :
    WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ ε
proof:
:= by
  unfold WeightedFourier
  set P2 : ℝ := ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2
  have hP2 : 0 ≤ P2 := by positivity
  have hbase := weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages (σ + 1) (s - σ)
    (fun lam => ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2)
    (fun u => a u * P2) (fun _ => by positivity) (fun u => mul_nonneg (ha u) hP2) hshell
  have hpre : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
  calc (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ (s - σ)), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ (σ + 1)),
        ‖coef (σ + 1) (s - σ) (g + 2 ^ (s - σ) * k)‖ *
          ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ))
            (g + 2 ^ (s - σ) * k)‖ ^ 2
